notes.title: I’ve found a publisher!
notes.notes:
First of all, I just wanted to say thank you to everyone who has been following my development journey so far! I really appreciate all of your support and I can’t wait to share more with you.

I’m excited to tell you all that I’m officially partnering with UK-based publisher Kwalee to launch lily’s world XD!

If you want more detailed updates on how the development of lily’s world XD is going, then don’t forget to subscribe to my free newsletter [b][url=https://sonderingemily.substack.com/]here[/url][/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195580/lilys_world_XD/
You can also follow me on YouTube or Instagram at @sonderingemily for even more indie game dev content.

notes.title: I'm working on the demo + Preview!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm so excited to see the support for lily's world XD. I've gotten some questions about whether the game will have a demo, and the answer is yes! I finished a build, got some feedback, and now I'm iterating for the second round of playtesting. I'm not sure exactly when I will launch the demo but sometime in 2025.

Here's a sneak peek of the demo, a dress up game! I was inspired by the girlie flash games I played as a kid, so I made my own version.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r2ALQpC.png[/img]
For those who are interested in a more intimate look into my development process, I have [url=https://sonderingemily.substack.com/]a free newsletter[/url] where I send updates every month. If you're interested in playtesting, I will have a sign up form and details in my next email! [url=https://sonderingemily.substack.com/]Join here[/url].

Thank you everyone for wishlisting lily's world XD! We have surpassed 20k wishlists. If you want to support lily's world XD, please wishlist and share the game with your friends.

More exciting updates to come!
